limits: Archive includes diagnostic sources, canonical fixture products, raw timings/results, native gcov JSON, build/test/preflight failures, remote snapshots, report and pre-final reviews. Linked libraries/executables, neutral identity copies, dependency jars and external checkout/build products are hash-bound in protocols/source/runtime freezes but not all copied into this archive. No claim of a self-contained binary toolchain archive. Final reviews occur after this immutable manifest and bind its hash; their outcome is a separate asset. All quality gates remain false except explicitly scoped correctness/no-signal submatrices.

revision.reason: Independent final evidence review required authoritative existing Surefire XML; publisher atomic checkpoint/ZIP correction also reviewed. No source/test/timing change.
